identity.title: ALMA resolves molecular clouds in metal-poor Magellanic Bridge A

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using the ALMA telescope including the Morita Array, we mapped with sub-parsec resolution a 3$'$  field of view centered on the Magellanic Bridge A molecular cloud, in 1.3 mm continuum emission and (2$-$1) line emission.

findings_qualitative.value: No 1.3 mm continuum detected; upper limits compatible with MBB extrapolation

evidence.quote: Our limits are compatible with the extrapolation of the MBB fits and therefore we cannot independently confirm the excess at this longer wavelength.

claims.hypothesis: The 870 um excess in Bridge A extends to 1.3 mm
claims.experiment: ALMA 12m+7m 1.3 mm continuum compared to MBB fit of FIR SED
claims.result: No detection; upper limits <1.5, <3.7, <1.4 times predicted
claims.finding: Excess cannot be confirmed at 1.3 mm; either extended and resolved out or process peaking at 870 um

evidence.quote: our ALMA 1.3 mm data are on the sensitivity limit compatible with the MBB fit to the far-infrared observations, and show no excess at this wavelength.

claims.hypothesis: CO(2-1) emission resolves into compact dense clouds
claims.result: Two ~1 pc clouds with virial masses ~437 and 733 Msun
claims.finding: Densities higher than typical Milky Way bulk densities

evidence.quote: Their bulk volume densities are $n(H_2)\sim0.7-2.6\times10^3$ cm$^{-3}$, larger than typical bulk densities of Galactic molecular clouds.

claims.hypothesis: Dust-derived gas mass exceeds CO-traced mass
claims.experiment: Compare MBB gas masses to virial masses
claims.finding: Extended cold envelope not emitting in CO

evidence.quote: the gas mass estimates from the FIR dust continuum MBB fit to sources North and South are a factor of $\sim3-4$ larger than virial masses from CO

why_this_method.value: Natural weighting chosen for higher sensitivity
